description:
Andrew Morgan LLC (AM)  is a fast-growing Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We are seeking a Technology Business Management (TBM) Developer to sustain a federal client's current TBM platform while designing and building its replacement: a custom TBM cost modeling and reporting solution on Microsoft Power Platform.

 This individual will keep the existing Apptio-based TBM model and monthly reporting cycle running through cutover. In parallel, they will serve as the full-stack Power Platform developer for the new solution, from requirements and user experience through data modeling, allocation logic, testing, and Power BI reporting.

 The ideal candidate combines hands-on Power Platform engineering with a working understanding of TBM and IT financial management. They can translate cost allocation concepts into working applications and data models, and they are comfortable owning a product end to end in a fast-moving federal environment.

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Sustain the current TBM platform through cutover

 
 Maintain and run the existing Apptio TBM cost model, including cost pools, IT towers, solutions, and business-unit consumption layers aligned to the TBM Taxonomy.

 Support the monthly model refresh cycle, including Alteryx-fed data loads, troubleshooting of data and allocation issues, and production of the model by month-end.

 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks so model outputs tie to authoritative financial sources such as the agency's financial and budget systems.

 Document current-state model logic, allocation rules, drivers, and reports to serve as the baseline for migration.

 
 Build the Power Platform TBM solution

 
 Serve as a full-stack Power Platform developer for a custom TBM cost modeling and reporting solution, using Power Apps, Power BI and supporting Microsoft data services.

 Gather and document requirements with Government finance, IT, and portfolio stakeholders, and translate them into user stories, data models, and application designs.

 Support the design of the user experience for model administration, mapping maintenance, and data review, including app screens, workflows, and navigation.

 Support the design and implementation of the data model and cost allocation logic that maps spend from financial accounts through technology resources to the applications, services, and business units that consume them.

 Integrate ETL outputs from Alteryx workflows and other source data into the new solution's data layer.

 Rebuild and modernize existing Apptio reports as Power BI dashboards that show IT spend, unit costs, trends, variances, and consumption.

 Execute testing, including unit, integration, and parallel-run testing that reconciles new-solution outputs against Apptio before cutover.

 Apply sound application lifecycle management practices, including solution packaging, environment management, source control, and controlled deployment in a GCC environment.

 Support migration of mappings, historical data, and reports from Apptio to the new solution.

 
 Across both workstreams

 
 Support federal IT portfolio and budget reporting, including alignment of cost data to OMB IT Portfolio, CPIC reporting, and the TBM Taxonomy.

 Create and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, solution design documents, allocation logic, data-flow diagrams, user guides, and standard operating procedures.

 Ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, professional, timely, and compliant with applicable Government standards, including Section 508.

 Provide status updates, identify issues and risks, and contribute to client briefings and deliverables.

 Model Andrew Morgan's expectations for responsiveness, accountability, collaboration, client service, and solution-oriented problem solving.

 
 REQUIREMENTS:  

 
 3+ years of experience in application development, financial systems development, TBM, IT financial management, or a related technical role.

 Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

 Hands-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps (canvas and/or model-driven) and Dataverse or SQL-based data sources.

 Working knowledge of the TBM Taxonomy and TBM concepts, including cost pools, towers, solutions, and cost allocation methodologies.

 Hands-on experience building or maintaining cost models, financial data models, or analytics solutions that combine data from multiple sources.

 Proficiency with SQL and relational data modeling.

 Experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI.

 Experience supporting activities end to end, including requirements gathering, user experience design, and testing.

 Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to reconcile data, investigate variances, and explain results clearly.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

 Ability to satisfy applicable Government personnel suitability and security requirements and to complete required Government privacy and information-security training.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 
 Hands-on experience with Apptio (IBM Apptio, ApptioOne, Cloudability, or Targetprocess) or another TBM or IT financial management platform, especially in a migration or replacement effort.

 Microsoft Certified Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600).

 TBM Council certification (Certified TBM Analyst or Certified TBM Professional) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.

 Experience with Power Platform application lifecycle management, including solutions, environment strategy, pipelines, and source control.

 Experience deploying Power Platform solutions in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC).

 Experience with Alteryx or other ETL tools, and with Python or other scripting languages.

 Experience supporting federal agencies, including familiarity with federal budget formulation and execution, appropriations, and IT portfolio reporting.

 Experience working with federal financial systems or data sources such as Oracle, SAP, CGI Momentum, or agency general ledger and procurement systems.

 Experience analyzing cloud billing data from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and supporting cloud cost optimization.

 Experience developing Section 508-compliant federal applications and deliverables in high-visibility environments with short-turn deadlines and multiple stakeholders.

 
 SALARY: 

 Base Salary: $125,000 - $140,000

 Salary is commensurate with both location and experience.

 THE AM EMPLOYEE WILL DISPLAY… 

 
 Attention to Detail: Produce high-quality deliverables and outputs that align with contract outcomes.

 Self-Sufficiency: Execute tasks independently, seeking client assistance only after internal resources are exhausted, ensuring requests align with contract goals.

 Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with team members, including AMC resources, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.

 Communication/Engagement: Maintain professional conduct in meetings and written communication, participating actively with cameras on.

 Responsiveness: Stay engaged, communicate promptly, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

 
 ABOUT ANDREW MORGAN… 

 Andrew Morgan LLC, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Alexandria, VA, is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We specialize in delivering high-quality consulting services to both federal and commercial clients, offering expertise in Strategy and Management Consulting, Technology & Architecture Services, and Industry & Mission Analytics Solutions. Our distinguished clientele includes the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the Department of Defense (DoD), and the United Stated Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). We are committed to providing innovative solutions and exceptional service to support our clients' missions and objectives. 

 BENEFITS: 

 
 15 days of Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Federal Holidays

 401K Program (up to 4% employer matching)

 Three Gold Healthcare Options (with 75%-90% employer-paid premiums)

 Flexible Spending Account / Dependent Care Assistance Program

 Employer-Paid Short Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Long Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Life Insurance 

 Professional Training and Development

 Corporate Team Building Events

 And MORE!

 
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: 

 Andrew Morgan does not discriminate in employment opportunities, terms and conditions of employment, or practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, gender, religious or political beliefs, national origin or heritage, disability, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law. ​
